messages.subject: Retained sample inspection protocol — Halstead/Ferncliffe
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Following the order, I've spoken to Ferncliffe's expert about the joint inspection of the retained coupons. We're agreed on sectioning locations and on re-running oxygen by inert-gas fusion and the microhardness traverses at an independent lab to avoid any 'whose kit' argument. I'll send a short agreed protocol for the solicitors to approve. The beta-fleck and alpha-case points remain my central findings and I don't expect them to change.

Aileen

Dr Aileen Frost, CEng FIMMM | Argent Metallurgical Services
